method: Each region was rendered at 200 dpi and inspected with an image viewer. The judgement recorded is what was actually seen, not what the detector claimed.

regions.observed: complete two-panel mechanism diagram (a/b), no body text, no cropping
four-panel similarity matrices a/b/c/d with colourbar; panel letters intact; body text above correctly excluded after the gap-scan fix
complete training/evaluation schematic, no cropping, no prose

known_limits: Captions on a different page from their figure are missed (rare in Nature).
Papers using a non-standard caption convention are missed entirely -- a false negative, which is safer than the old detector's false positives but still a gap.
The gap threshold (20 pt) is a constant; a figure with an unusually large internal gap could be truncated at that gap.
Only main-text and Extended Data captions are recognised; Methods figures are not.
note: The OLD detector scored roughly 50 % on a similar manual check (the audit found pages of prose and cropped figures). This detector was rewritten to anchor on captions instead of merging ink rectangles, and the failures found by looking -- body-text contamination, cropped panel letters -- were fixed and re-checked.
